name: G4 Real-Task Window Parity

cases.title: G4 Real Task Window Parity - LongCat Short 64k
cases.taskGoal: Review the current Project Yggdrasil repository and produce a final release brief for pseudo-infinite context parity. The brief must first judge whether this is a high-value real task for the current repo, then synthesize the global integration chain across runtime, evaluation, protocol, provider, documentation, and evidence surfaces. The final answer must explicitly decide whether a realistic short-window path can be treated as equivalent to a realistic long-window reference for the current repo state.
cases.currentObjective: Turn the current repo state into a release-ready parity judgment across realistic context windows without dropping cross-surface evidence.

currentContext.title: task value contract
currentContext.content: This must be a real repo-wide integration task, not a synthetic long prompt. In the first section, explicitly judge whether the task is high value for the current project and explain why. The answer must treat the repo as a real engineering system and not as a toy example.

currentContext.title: required output structure
currentContext.content: The final structure must be: 1) 任务价值判断, 2) 联调覆盖范围, 3) 关键集成链路, 4) short-window 配置, 5) long-window 配置, 6) acceptance 对照结论, 7) 风险与下一步. The conclusion section must state whether the task effect is equivalent across the two windows and why. After section 7, append a formal delivery footer with the exact Markdown headings '## 结果', '## 证据', '## 风险', '## 已知问题'.

currentContext.title: window policy
currentContext.content: Use realistic windows rather than toy windows. For this run, the short-window profile represents a constrained but still practical working set. Your judgment must explicitly distinguish acceptable differences in cost or latency from unacceptable differences in final delivery quality.

currentContext.title: delivery mode contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is disabled for this case. Treat the provided context files and repo context as the evidence set. Do not describe future scanning, reading, listing, or tool usage. Do not mention MCP. Start immediately with the final Markdown brief using these exact section headings: '## 1. 任务价值判断', '## 2. 联调覆盖范围', '## 3. 关键集成链路', '## 4. short-window 配置', '## 5. long-window 配置', '## 6. acceptance 对照结论', '## 7. 风险与下一步'. After section 7, append the formal delivery footer headings '## 结果', '## 证据', '## 风险', '## 已知问题'.

acceptanceRejectPhrases: 我会先总结当前局势，再给出最稳妥的下一步
我会按这个顺序推进，确保每一步都可验证。
先完成仓库现状的快速扫描
Do not stop at planning or next-steps summary.
cases.responseRequirements: Produce the complete release brief directly. Required sections: 1) 任务价值判断 (must contain '高价值' judgment), 2) 联调覆盖范围, 3) 关键集成链路, 4) short-window 配置, 5) long-window 配置, 6) acceptance 对照结论 (must explicitly state 等价 or 不等价), 7) 风险与下一步. After the 7 required sections, append a formal delivery footer using the exact Markdown headings '## 结果', '## 证据', '## 风险', '## 已知问题'. Ensure sections 6 and 7 are present at the end of the final answer even if the brief is long. Output Markdown only. Do not emit XML tags, tool tags, MCP tags, <tool_calls>, or planning preambles. Do not stop at planning or next-steps summary.
cases.restartMessage: Window restart: you must now produce the final release brief with all 7 required sections: 1) 任务价值判断 (含 '高价值'), 2) 联调覆盖范围, 3) 关键集成链路, 4) short-window 配置, 5) long-window 配置, 6) acceptance 对照结论 (必须写明等价/不等价), 7) 风险与下一步. After the 7 required sections, append a formal delivery footer using the exact Markdown headings '## 结果', '## 证据', '## 风险', '## 已知问题'. Ensure sections 6 and 7 are included at the end. Output Markdown only and do not emit XML/tool/MCP tags. Deliver the complete structured output, not a plan.
